notes: BIC uses identification/training RSS and independent fitted complex coefficients; validation is diagnostic.
Greedy structure search: a local stopping decision, not proof of global optimality.
The RSS form assumes zero-mean residuals; correlated/periodic IQ samples may affect BIC interpretation.
LUT extension conditional on its training-derived grid: n=rank of fitted gains; grid estimation is not penalized.
